## Funding Distribution by Stage

Box plots are not natively supported in Grafana.

**Fields:** `stage` vs `funding_amount`

Consider using the [Plotly panel plugin](https://grafana.com/grafana/plugins/natel-plotly-panel/) or the Business Charts (Apache ECharts) plugin for box plot support.
